title: Remove duplicate FR customer and vendor ledger entry tables
summary: Removed duplicate FR-specific customer and vendor ledger entry table sources to allow the materialized FR view to inherit W1 sources and reduce duplicate maintenance.
key_points: Eliminates 3092 lines of duplicate FR table definitions
FR view now inherits W1 customer and vendor ledger entry sources
Reduces ongoing maintenance burden by consolidating to single source
Requires merge of PR #13861 first to ensure FR and W1 customer sources are identical
Vendor table sources were already byte-identical
quote: Remove the redundant FR customer and vendor ledger entry table sources so the materialized FR view inherits the W1 sources.
